Hi Mathieu.

What is your plan for the analysis? What does 'n=4, N=8' mean?

Regardless, it seems like you might start with the "coreR1" CDF from:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/raex-1-0-st-v1

... and you could follow the use-case from (replacing the human exon
with rat exon where necessary):

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis

... after setting everything up on your system:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/setup
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/directory-structures

Hope that helps.
Mark
